kernelChecks.definition: Actual emitted6502 callbacks for correctness only. Independent integer/mask/convex oracles plus unoptimized native controls. No CPU replay FPS.

materialCacheChecks.checks: Both buffers, sparse/disconnected/adjacent/overlapping span unions; screen palette and color RAM compared after every row

target: VICE Turbo6510 PALx64; safe presentation; Colodore/filter0; silent qualification fixtures, sound off
protocol: 128simulation-event warm-up; full2048tick automatic route,~40.8emulated seconds; fresh complete view count and trace agree. No host/warp/CPU replay FPS.
nativePoseProtocol: Frozen equal camera inputs,three completed views; park main PC in an existing self-JMP with IRQs active for three PAL raster0events. Resume after IRQ exit. No code or framebuffer edits; new-view count unchanged while parked. This settles VIC palette scanout, not an FPS run.
rawEvidence: External development reports/,raw/,build/,artifacts/ and launch.ps1; excluded from source SDK
publicPackageGates: Results for the final exact source ZIP are recorded in the external delivery receipt
limits: New options qualified in Mode4 plus only; other precision/mode defaults remain unchanged
Frozen lighting intentionally changes moving-light appearance and rejects shared-source instances
Automatic fan merge keeps original material-cell ownership on mixed palettes using the complete fallback
Extra code/data consumes measured64KB RAM; allocator can reject larger scenes
PAL caps visible new views near50.125/s; gains are scene-dependent
Transient native palette scanout screenshots without parking are diagnostic only, not promoted pixel evidence
